findings.evidence: File imports only `RealClosure/AlgebraicClosed`, `LinearFactor`, `RealClosed/Quadratic` — the same set as `TauCeti/FieldTheory/RealClosure/IVT.lean:8-10` — and uses the same `WfDvdMonoid.induction_on_irreducible` / `natDegree_le_two_of_irreducible` argument (PolynomialSigns.lean:33,38 vs IVT.lean:41,62). Its only Sturm use is `SturmInfinity.lean:46,59`.
findings.fix: Move the file next to the other real-closed polynomial sign material, e.g. `TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/RealClosed/SignAtInfinity.lean` (sibling of `RealClosed/Quadratic.lean`, which it imports) or `TauCeti/FieldTheory/RealClosure/`, and update the import in `SturmInfinity.lean`.
findings.issue: `Polynomial.sign_at_top`/`sign_at_bot` are general facts about polynomial signs beyond a field-valued bound over a real closed field; they are in the root `Polynomial` namespace, depend on no Sturm theory, and are broadly useful, but live inside the Sturm subdirectory where only their consumer lives.

findings.evidence: Proof uses only `variation_eq` (SturmSigns.lean:154), `List.map_map`, `sign_mul/sign_pos/sign_neg`, and Mathlib's `List.signVariations_map` / `signVariations_map_of_sign_eq_neg` (mathlib/Mathlib/Data/List/SignVariations.lean:105,129). No `Remainder`/`Signed` hypothesis appears in statement or proof.
findings.fix: Move `variation_mul` into `SturmSigns.lean`, after `variation_eq` and before the `variable [IsRealClosed R]` block.
findings.issue: `variation_mul` is a lemma about `variation` under multiplication of all entries by a fixed polynomial; it uses nothing from the signed-remainder relation, yet sits at the end of the `Signed`/`Remainder` file, three modules after `variation` is defined.

findings.evidence: Grep of SignedRemainders.lean for `zeros`, `eq_right`, `eq_left`, `Regular.sum`, `sum_of_regular` yields only an unrelated `ite_eq_right` hit at line 228; the file's needs are `Regular`/`Regular.second_ne` (SturmLocal.lean:21,159) and `variation` (SturmSigns.lean). `SturmTarski.lean` calls `hreg.sum hsimple0 hab ha0.2 hb0.2`.
findings.fix: Import `TauCeti.Algebra.Polynomial.Sturm.SturmLocal` here instead, and add `public import TauCeti.Algebra.Polynomial.Sturm.SturmSum` to `SturmTarski.lean`, which is the file that actually uses `Regular.sum`.
findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.Algebra.Polynomial.Sturm.SturmSum` is broader than the file's dependencies: no declaration from `SturmSum.lean` is referenced anywhere in it.

findings.evidence: The pre-existing file in that directory is `TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/Sturm/GCD.lean` (not `SturmGCD.lean`); globbing `TauCeti/**/{Borel/Borel,Center/Center,Derived/Derived,Connected/Connected}*.lean` and `RealClosure/RealClosure*.lean` returns no files, so no other directory in the repo stutters this way.
findings.fix: `git mv` them to `Sturm/Signs.lean`, `Sturm/Local.lean`, `Sturm/Sum.lean`, `Sturm/Tarski.lean`, `Sturm/Infinity.lean` and update the imports; no declaration renames needed.
findings.issue: Five new files repeat the directory name inside `Sturm/`: `SturmSigns.lean`, `SturmLocal.lean`, `SturmSum.lean`, `SturmTarski.lean`, `SturmInfinity.lean`. The shared `Sturm` component already names the directory, so the module paths read `Sturm.SturmSigns` etc., against the convention set by the directory's existing file.

summary: Three placement/import problems: a general real-closed-field sign-at-infinity file buried under Sturm/, a lemma about `variation` placed three files downstream of where `variation` is defined, and an over-broad public import. File names in Sturm/ also stutter against the directory and the existing Sturm/GCD.lean.
